item.title: Version 2.4.1
item.description:
What's new in 2.4.1

  • Collars, bows and hats sit right on every cat breed
  • On cats with a collar in their drawing, the worn collar goes right over it

item.title: Version 2.4.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.4.0

  • Choose Come Here! with the pointer on another screen and your pet walks over, and its things move with it.
  • Steps aside when its screen goes full screen for a presentation, a film or a game, and comes back when it ends.
  • Optional: follows you to the screen you have been working on for ten minutes; office visitors can stay on a screen of their own.
  • Notices a display being plugged in or pulled out. Screens stacked one above the other now work: a pet carried up lands on that floor and can be carried back down.

item.title: Version 2.3.1
item.description:
What's new in 2.3.1

  • Several screens: your pet lives on one of them and is never cut in half at the seam between two displays.
  • Drag your pet onto another screen and it moves in there — bowls, litter box and toys come along.
  • Lighter with three or four displays: screens without a pet no longer redraw the scene.

item.title: Version 2.3.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.3.0

  • A dolphin: it lives in a strip of sea above your Dock, swims, leaps, dives and surfaces somewhere else.
  • Feed it and a fish falls into the water; the dolphin hunts it down or catches it in mid-air.
  • Beach ball, a squirt at your cursor, its own tricks and a real recorded dolphin call.

item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.2.0

  • Pets notice each other: a visitor from the office and your pet say hello, sniff, chase each other and go for the same ball.
  • Tricks: teach your pet to sit and spin — a dog also gives a paw and plays dead, a monkey waves and flips, a cat high-fives. Practice makes perfect.
  • A new pet starts small and grows up over its first three weeks.
  • A widget for your desktop and Notification Center, with your pet and its needs.
  • Real recorded voices: a dog barks and a monkey chatters when you pet them.
  • Install with Homebrew: brew install --cask unbelievable-digital/tap/unbelievable-jungle

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.1.0

  • Three new breeds: a golden retriever and a corgi for dog people, and a snow monkey.
  • Dogs and monkeys have voices of their own: a dog yips when you pet it, a monkey chatters.
  • A monkey leaves hand prints on the glass, not paw prints, and reaches for the close button with its hand.
  • The menu bar icon is your pet's own animal — a cat, a dog or a monkey — and changes the moment you change it.

item.title: Version 2.0.1
item.description:
What's new in 2.0.1

  • Every animal now eats, plays and goes in its own way: a monkey gets bananas on a leaf and a coconut, a dog gets a bone on its dinner, a tennis ball and a pee pad.
  • The thought bubble and Pet Home show your animal's own food and toy.
  • If Unbelievable Cat opened when you logged in, Unbelievable Jungle now does too — or asks, if it cannot tell.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.0.0

  • Unbelievable Cat is now Unbelievable Jungle — and your pet can be a cat, a dog or a monkey.
  • Coming from Unbelievable Cat? Your cat comes with you: its name, how well it knows you, its needs, its office and its polaroids. Unbelievable Cat hands it over and closes itself.
  • Each animal has its own nature. A dog stays close, begs and fetches the ball back — and never climbs your windows. A monkey climbs everything, and the yarn and your mug are not safe.
  • Dogs and monkeys speak English, Turkish and Bulgarian in their own way, and have jokes of their own.
  • Accessories fit every animal. The office works across animals too: a dog can visit a cat's screen.
  • A new icon.
